'''Kir-Tja Dilsn''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], an injured Dilsn stopped over on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Iktotch/Legends|Iktotch]] to recover. He later required transport to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]], and a group of [[Heroes of Cularin|freelance agents]] collected him aboard their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], temporarily stopping over at the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]] while en route to the world.

==Biography==
[[File:Jedi_symbol.svg|thumb|left|200px|Kir-Tja Dilsn served in the Jedi Order (emblem pictured) during the Republic Era.]]
Kir-Tja Dilsn was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] as a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] during the waning [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], Dilsn was elderly.<ref name="TAUT" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], ''[[Looking In: The Air Up Thaere|The Air Up Thaere]]'' is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> after suffering several injuries, Dilsn had surgery performed on his [[Limb/Legends|leg]] and hip, and, following the procedure, he recovered from the operation on the<ref name="TAUT" /> [[Moon/Legends|moon]]<ref name="TCWCG">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[Iktotch/Legends|Iktotch]]. Later, while he was still not fully healed, Dilsn required transport to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]],<ref name="TAUT" /> the site of a [[Almas Academy|Jedi academy]].<ref name="LFCG">''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]''</ref> The [[Heroes of Cularin]], a group of freelance [[Agent/Legends|agents]] from the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], agreed to take Diln to Almas in their [[Starship/Legends|starship]], and they subsequently collected him from Iktotch.<ref name="TAUT" />

En route to Almas, the agents landed their ship on [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] located in the [[Thaereian system]], in order to [[Fuel/Legends|refuel]]. However, while they were there, the rogue [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Thaereian Intelligence|intelligence]] operative [[Xirossk]] stole the starship's [[PU-36 modulator chip|modulator chip]], preventing the craft's [[Sublight engine/Legends|sublight engines]] from working. The agents set out to recover the chip while Dilsn opted to remain aboard the starship and guard it, as his injuries prevented him from pursuing the [[Saboteur/Legends|saboteur]]. The agents eventually recovered the chip and departed Burnout with Dilsn.<ref name="TAUT" />

==Powers and abilities==
Dilsn was a [[Jedi training/Legends|trained]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight, and he possessed the ability to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] a starship.<ref name="TAUT" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kir-Tja Dilsn was created by [[Lee Pickler]] and [[Morrie Mullins (real person)|Morrie Mullins]], and he appeared in ''[[Looking In: The Air Up Thaere|The Air Up Thaere]]'', a [[Star Wars Roleplaying Game|roleplaying]] supplement for the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign. During the scenario, if none of the players&mdash;who [[Roleplaying game|roleplay]] as the agents transporting Dilsn&mdash;are pilots, Dilsn flies their ship for them when they leave Burnout.<ref name="TAUT" />
